story.title: My Journey
story.p1: I am a professional graduated as an IT Technician from UNIVAP (2024), passionate about technology and web development. My journey began with programming in languages like Java, C#, Python, JavaScript and PHP, always seeking to combine creativity and logic to solve real problems.
story.p2: I have experience in ASP.NET Web Forms and Windows Forms, working since February 2025 as a Programmer at APTIV, where I develop and maintain applications to support internal processes, dashboards and integration with relational databases. I am also the founder of Energon, my digital solutions company.
story.p3: My passion for web development led me to explore modern frameworks, such as React and Next.js, in addition to deepening my knowledge in relational and non-relational databases. I believe that the combination between robust back-end and dynamic front-end is essential to deliver complete, scalable and intuitive solutions.

energon.title: Energon - Digital Solutions
energon.description: Institutional website for my technology company. Modern platform to present custom systems and websites, with portfolio, sales process, bilingual support (PT/EN), light/dark theme and quote form. Built with Next.js, Prisma and deployed on Railway.

reviewweb.title: ReviewWEB - Review Management Platform
reviewweb.description: Complete review management platform developed for Ben Sheridan. Allows companies to strategically manage their online reputation by collecting reviews through customized public pages and applying intelligent flows based on the rating received. Includes real-time metrics dashboard, automatic notifications, data export and bilingual interface with Dark Mode.

rifaflow.title: RifaFlow - Raffle Management System
rifaflow.description: Complete raffle management system developed for RifaFlow Brasil with advanced features and real-time integration. Includes complete reservation management, status control, advanced search and filter system, CSV data export, real-time synchronization and statistics dashboard. Responsive and intuitive interface optimized for mobile and desktop.

finantech.title: FinanTech Solutions - Expense Manager
finantech.description: Modern and complete solution for business financial management. System developed in React with transaction registration, dynamic charts for monthly and category analysis, CSV and PDF export, intelligent search, financial goals panel, change history and authentication. Modern visual with animations, glassmorphism, responsiveness and automatic dark mode.
